operator: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
waters_covered: about 130 lakes and reservoirs (state parks, wildlife areas, sampled lakes)
access_detail: Linked from cdphe.colorado.gov/toxic-algae ("Data"). CSV via https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rnsdGU5IrrCt3jfYQGa3obDd7SN27R1mitLhilBvYSQ/export?format=csv (no auth). 198 rows on 2026-11-03: Waterbody name, Condition Category (No bloom reported, Caution, Warning, Third party), Update Date, Other notes; latest update 2026-09-09.
